aboutGame.title: What is Drive-Thru Empire?
paragraphs: Drive-Thru Empire is an engaging fast-food restaurant simulation and car-collecting tycoon experience on Roblox developed by DRAIN CCU Games. Players build and expand their very own drive-thru empire, taking customer orders, serving quality meals, and rolling for prestigious supercars to dramatically scale their cash profits.

From a modest single-lane roadside diner to a sprawling culinary mega-franchise with automated cooking stations and exotic luxury vehicles, our wiki provides complete guides, upgrade paths, and optimal earning strategies to help you dominate the business leaderboard.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Drive-Thru Empire on Roblox.

items.question: What is Drive-Thru Empire on Roblox?
items.answer: Drive-Thru Empire is a popular fast-food restaurant simulation and car-collecting tycoon on Roblox developed by DRAIN CCU Games. Players build and manage their own drive-thru restaurants, roll for rare supercars, serve hungry customers, and scale their profits through kitchen automation.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Drive-Thru Empire?
items.answer: To redeem codes in Drive-Thru Empire, open the game on Roblox, locate and click the Codes or Settings button on your screen, enter any active promo code exactly as written, and click Redeem to receive free cash and bonus rewards.

items.question: How do cars work in Drive-Thru Empire?
items.answer: In Drive-Thru Empire, collecting and rolling for rare vehicles is essential. High-tier cars like supercars and hypercars bring VIP customers to your drive-thru window, awarding significantly larger cash tips and passive revenue multipliers compared to starter vehicles.

items.question: What are the best upgrades to buy first in Drive-Thru Empire?
items.answer: Beginners in Drive-Thru Empire should first invest in cooking speed and automated kitchen stations (such as griddles and fryers) to eliminate customer backlogs, followed by driveway expansion and car rolls to maximize per-order profits.

items.question: How often does Drive-Thru Empire receive updates?
items.answer: The developers at DRAIN CCU Games actively maintain Drive-Thru Empire with regular weekly patches, introducing new collectible supercars, fresh promotional codes, expanded kitchen equipment, and community-requested gameplay improvements.
